newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank sets reverse repo at fixed 4.60 percent.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank sets reverse repo at fixed 4.60 percent.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, set on Tuesday a new seven-day reverse repurchase operation at a fixed rate of 4.60 percent.
The Riksbank announced last Thursday that this repo and the three subsequent tenders would be set at 4.60 percent in a move which brings Sweden's central bank into line with European practice.

The repo rate, which is the Riksbank's key tool for controlling money market liquidity, has been cut on 23 occasions this year from its January level of 8.91 percent as inflation propensity in Sweden has fallen to a minimum.
The other two elements of the central bank's rate corridor, the deposit and lending rates, were cut on Thursday by 50 basis points to 4.25 percent and 5.75 percent respectively.
The new repo tender will run from October 30 to November 6 with all bids to be received by 0900 GMT on October 29.
